projects.title: FlowML - AI-Powered Visual ML Pipeline Builder
projects.description: FlowML is an AI-powered AutoML platform that simplifies machine learning through a visual, drag-and-drop pipeline builder. Users can analyze datasets, automate preprocessing, train and compare classification or regression models, visualize results, and generate predictions through one intuitive interface.

projects.title: SpendWise - Private Personal Finance Manager
projects.description: SpendWise is an offline-first Android finance app that helps users track expenses, analyze spending habits, and manage their money privately. Featuring interactive analytics, transaction management, biometric security, and PDF/CSV exports, it keeps financial data stored locally without cloud sync or advertising.

projects.title: ParkSync - Intelligent AI Parking Management System
projects.description: ParkSync is an intelligent, full-stack parking management system that streamlines vehicle entry, parking slot allocation, exit management, fee calculation, and invoicing. It uses computer vision and OCR technology to detect vehicle number plates, PostgreSQL to manage parking records, and an interactive command-center dashboard to monitor parking occupancy, revenue, and active sessions.

experience: Led concept framing and visual direction across the product narrative.
Designed polished UI patterns that balanced clarity, personality, and speed of understanding.
